entry.title: ProstoCAD 0.16.2: Chamfers that stop at the edge
entry.content:
Added

  • A chamfer wider than a face stops at the face's far edge instead of failing: a 2.5 mm chamfer on a 2 mm face is a 2 mm one.
  • Fillet and chamfer sizes start at 0.5 mm in every dialog; the arrows step by 0.1 mm.

Fixed

  • A click on a feature in the tree no longer hangs on parts with lettering (25-30 s before).
  • Appearance on many faces is fast again (55 s before, now under a second).
